en: The postcard features a sepia portrait photograph of a man in early 20th-century military uniform, with insignia and decorations typical of Prussian nobility. Below the image is a caption identifying him as 'Prinz Oskar von Preussen.' In the bottom corner, it credits the photograph to 'Ernst Sandau, Kgl. Hofphot., Berlin W.' The back of the card includes printed guidelines for address and stamp, a blue stamp for the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont,' and handwritten numbers.
